qualification: 3-year Diploma or Science Graduate + Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving License as on 13.05.2026. Min. 60% for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS; 50% for SC/ST/PwBD. Certificate course in Fire/Safety (min. 6 months) is an added advantage.
age_limit: All age calculations are as on the cut-off date 13.05.2026. No age relaxation is available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates applying for FTE positions.
application_fee: The application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances. Payment is accepted online via Debit/Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking. Incomplete applications or those with failed/pending payment status will not be considered.
selection_process: For S/G E0 (Jr. Executive - Chemical, Mechanical, Fire & Safety) || The selection comprises Computer Based Test (CBT), Skill Test, and Personal Interview - all elimination rounds. Candidates qualifying in Skill Test are referred to Personal Interview. Physical Fitness Efficiency Test and Pre-Employment Medical Examination are additionally applicable for E0 positions. || Overall qualifying (CBT + Skill Test + Personal Interview): 60% for UR/EWS; 54% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD. || For S/G E1 & E2 (Asst. Engineer/Officer, Engineer/Officer, Asst. Accounts Officer) || Selection comprises CBT, Group Task/Group Discussion, and Personal Interview. For Medical Officer (E2), only Personal Interview is conducted. || Overall qualifying (CBT + GD + PI): 60% for UR/EWS; 54% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD. || For S/G E3 & E5 (Senior Engineer, Senior Manager) || Selection comprises Technical Competency Interview and Behavioural Competency Interview by a constituted panel. Shortlisting from applications may be done based on relevant experience, qualification marks, and age in case of large application numbers. || Overall qualifying (Technical + Behavioural Interview): 60% for UR/EWS; 54% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD. || For FTE Positions (Plant Heads) || Selection through Personal Interview comprising Technical Competency Assessment and Behavioural Competency Assessment conducted by the Selection Committee. || CBT Structure (applicable for E0, E1, E2) || The CBT has no negative marking and comprises two parts: General Aptitude (English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning & Data Interpretation) and Technical/Professional Knowledge (questions related to qualifying degree and practical knowledge for the applied position). Detailed syllabus will be uploaded on the HRRL website in due course.
